posts.title: Personal Thought: On the Concept of "Inat"
posts.description: I recently learned that in Serbia and the Balkans region of Europe there’s a concept called “ Inat " (pronunciation: EE - nat ). There is no English word that directly translates into what Inat is, but Inat is a combination of: stubbornness, persistence, fearlessness, resilience, and toughness. Inat is the force that any underdog leverages to push through, keep fighting, and prove doubters wrong.
